* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query

* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.

description:

:Minimal

**Who are we?**
Amdocs helps the world’s leading communications and media companies deliver exceptional customer experiences through reliable, efficient, and secure operations at scale. We provide software products and services that embed intelligence into how work runs across business, IT, and network domains –delivering measurable outcomes in customer experience, network performance, cloud modernization, and revenue growth. With our talented people, and more than forty years of experience running mission-critical systems around the globe, Amdocs runs billions of transactions daily. Our technology is relied on every day, connecting people worldwide and advancing a more inclusive, connected world. Together, we help those who shape the future to make it amazing. Amdocs is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NASDAQ: DOX) and reported revenue of $4.53 billion in fiscal 2025. For more information, visit www.amdocs.com
  
  
At Amdocs, our mission is to empower our employees to 'Live Amazing, Do Amazing' every day. We believe in creating a workplace where you not only excel professionally but also thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world.
  
  
**In one sentence**
Designs, develops, modifies, debugs and/or maintains software systems.
  
  
**What will your job look like?**

* Maintain and operate internal engineering tools including Jira, Confluence, GitLab, SonarQube, Jenkins, Testlink.
* Administer users, projects, permissions, workflows, repositories, and configurations across owned platforms.
* Maintain and improve build (VMS written in Perl with Oracle DB usage) and auto test infrastructure(JATF).
* Maintain OpenStack environment: configuration, upgrade, hardware resource allocation, optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Provision and manage VMware-based test environments, including reusable VM templates.
* Install Oracle.Maintain Oracle as DBA - manage and clean tablespaces, tune performance, manage security.
* Support and optimize security scanning workflows (FOSS and Checkmarx), including CI/CD integration.
* Maintain core network services such as NIS, NFS, routing tables.
* Configure Apache, NGINX and SSL certificates.
* Perform deep troubleshooting of infrastructure, application, and network issues in collaboration with IT/Network teams.

**All you need is...**

* 10 to 15 years years of proven experience as a Infra engineer
* Strong Linux administration experience (RHEL preferred): services, patching, backups, performance troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Oracle on DBA level.
* Hands-on experience operating self-hosted engineering tools and their underlying stacks: Jira Server: MySQL + Apache Web Server Confluence Server: MySQL + Apache + Tomcat GitLab Server: NGINX (and GitLab services) SonarQube Server: SonarQube + plugins + Oracle Testlink: PHP + Apache + MySQL
* Experience with OpenStack operations: configuration, upgrades, optimization, quotas/projects/users, resource allocation.
* Experience with VMware provisioning and lifecycle management for test environments; ability to maintain VM templates.
* Good networking fundamentals and troubleshooting: IP addressing, subnetting/masking, routing basics, DNS concepts.
* Experience maintaining Apache and NGINX configurations, including TLS/SSL certificate deployment.
* Strong incident troubleshooting and RCA skills across application + OS + network layers; ability to document and operationalize fixes.

Would be a great advantage -
  
  

* Build infrastructure stack exposure: Apache WS, Tomcat WS, Perl, Bash scripting.
* CI/CD and automation: Jenkins, Groovy, Bash/Python scripting; workflow improvements and scheduling.
* Security enablement experience: FOSS compliance scanning and Checkmarx process automation.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for operational efficiency, workflow optimization, troubleshooting support, and knowledge‑base creation, with awareness of security and data‑handling considerations.
* NIS and NFS architecture knowledge with practical maintenance experience.
* Experience creating golden/base VM images and hardening OS templates.
* Observability: monitoring/logging/alerting practices for internal platforms.
* Ability to ramp-up quickly via internal knowledge transfer (KT) and convert KT into runbooks and SOPs

**Why You Will Love This Job**

* Work on mission-critical internal platforms.
* Exposure to a broad and challenging infrastructure stack.
* Opportunities for automation, ownership, and growth.
* Close collaboration with development, QA, security, and IT teams.

title: Technical Support Specialist/ Process Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cool Caps Industries is Eastern India’s largest manufacturer of beverage packaging and recycling solutions, providing caps, PET preforms, handles, and shrink film as a comprehensive raw material partner. The company integrates advanced recycling processes to produce high-quality RPET flakes from scrap plastic bottles and is investing in future B2B bottle-to-bottle initiatives using RPET granules. With operations across Uttarakhand, Assam, West Bengal, and Odisha, Cool Caps Industries supports a wide regional industrial footprint. The organization maintains a recycling capacity of over 15,000 MT and packaging capacity of over 25,000 MT, enabling scale and reliability for its customers. Team members join a growth-focused environment dedicated to innovation and sustainability in the packaging sector.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Technical Support Specialist/Process Engineer role is based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves monitoring and optimizing production processes for beverage packaging and recycling lines, ensuring stable operations, quality standards, and safety compliance. Daily tasks include troubleshooting technical issues with equipment, supporting plant operators, and implementing process control strategies to reduce downtime and improve efficiency. The position requires analyzing process data, identifying improvement opportunities, and assisting in designing or modifying process workflows to enhance throughput and resource utilization. The Specialist/Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, prepare technical documentation and reports, and support continuous improvement and sustainability initiatives within the plant.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Process Engineering and Process Design, with the ability to develop, review, and optimize manufacturing and recycling processes.
* Candidates should possess skills in Process Control and Analytical Skills, including monitoring key parameters, interpreting data, and implementing corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess knowledge in Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, with understanding of polymer, plastics, or packaging processes.
* Relevant skills in equipment troubleshooting, lean manufacturing or continuous improvement, and basic project management are beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, packaging, or recycling environments, along with familiarity with safety and environmental regulations, is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills, ability to work collaboratively on-site, and a structured, detail-oriented approach to problem-solving are expected.

Day-to-day responsibilities include managing ad platforms, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing key metrics, and implementing A/B tests to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine targeting, messaging, and landing pages, while preparing performance reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. The Performance Marketer will also stay updated on industry trends and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Campaign Strategy and Planning**

* Understand client/business objectives, target audience, offerings, funnel and conversion goals.
* Develop performance marketing strategies based on business objectives and available budgets.
* Plan campaign structures, audience strategy, creatives, messaging, placements and budgets.
* Define relevant KPIs and benchmarks before campaign launch.
* Develop full-funnel strategies across awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing, wherever relevant.

**2.**
**Campaign Execution**

* Independently set up, launch and manage campaigns across
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Manage campaign objectives, targeting, placements, budgets, bidding, ad sets/ad groups and creatives.
* Set up and monitor conversion events, pixels/tags and other relevant tracking requirements.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure campaigns have the right assets and messaging.

  .
* Conduct audience, creative, placement, budget and bidding optimization.
* Run structured A/B tests and document learnings.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action instead of simply increasing or decreasing budgets.

* Understand campaign tracking, conversion tracking and attribution fundamentals.
* Work with tools such as
  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/Events Manager and UTM tracking**
  .
* Analyse user journeys and conversion funnels to identify drop-offs.
* Ensure campaign data is reliable before drawing performance conclusions.

**5. Reporting & Insights**

* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Go beyond reporting numbers to explain
  **why performance changed and what should be done next**
  .
* Present campaign performance, key learnings, challenges and optimization recommendations to internal teams and clients.
* Connect advertising metrics with actual business outcomes such as qualified leads, sales, revenue and customer acquisition cost.

**6. Client & Team Collaboration**

* Communicate campaign strategy, performance and recommendations clearly to clients.
* Understand client requirements and proactively identify opportunities or concerns.
* Coordinate with social media, creative, content and design teams for campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple campaigns/accounts while maintaining timelines and performance standards.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery, Alcohol or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**

title: Audit & Assurance | Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
You will have the opportunity to work on multiple projects across industries that help organizations manage and mitigate risk, improve operational performance, and maximize enterprise value. In this role, you will build on your foundation to design, implement, assess and support risk management; provide advisory services; and assist in restructuring programs, reengineering processes, and frameworks to address the growing challenges and risks our clients face. You would have an opportunity to gain experience in:
  
  

* Providing extensive range of accounting and reporting services in addition to enhancing the overall value on financial reporting, technical and operational excellence related services delivered to the client.
* Assisting companies to understand, assess impact, and operationalize complex accounting and reporting changes resulting from shifting regulations, new accounting standards, corporate actions and capital market transactions.
* Driving operational efficiencies in the financial close and reporting process through providing efficient, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions aligned with accounting and financial reporting requirements.
* Support risk assessment for clients to identify prioritized list of risk/audit and helping plan the audit approach and scope, preparing the audit program, determining auditing procedures, seeing the audit process through completion, and applying internal audit standards
* Create internal control documentation for the engagement including narratives, process and data flows, and other supporting work papers
* Conduct/lead client interviews, communication and follow-ups
* Support various internal audit activities, including scoping, planning procedures, issuing requests, coordinating collection and examination of documentation, review and discussion of draft conclusions, management action plan and issuance of report to the client
* Mergers & Acquisitions related analysis of income statement trends to identify any one-time, non-cash or non-recurring items that may impact normalized earnings; analysis of normalized working capital, seasonality, cash and financial debt positions and potential adjustments for deal purposes and impact on free cash flow as well as evaluating the liabilities including any off-balance sheet items or contingent liabilities.
* Providing financial consulting services relating to business valuation for various classes of liabilities

and assets, including intangible asset; real and personal property; and various complex securities, including fixed-income securities, equities, derivatives, etc., using different valuation techniques models in accordance with US GAAP. Also, creating financial models, conducting industry research, and writing reports
  
  

* Apply a general knowledge of the technologies used to build complex IT environments and facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services
* Demonstrate understanding of business processes, internal control risk management, IT controls, and related regulatory and compliance standards
* Exercise professional skepticism, judgment and adhere to the code of ethics while on engagements

**Required Skills**

* Experience — 0 to 1 year
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), positive attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile
* Strong analytical, critical thinking/problem-solving skills and executive presence
* Experience with working in an ambiguous environment. Business mindset to understand the rationale behind the transactions, process workflow and ability and willingness to dive deeper into industry issues and bring greater insights for our clients
* Knowledge of accounting standards, financial management and technical concepts, strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels
* Willingness to expand skillset and work on other related areas

**Preferred Skills**

* Big 4 Articleship experience

**Qualification**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) - Rank Holder in CA Final will be preferred

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory
description:

Your impact
  
  
The Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory will lead the development and delivery of strategic advisory services for airports, governments, investors, airport operators, and infrastructure developers. The role will support clients in making informed decisions on airport development, expansion, investment, commercialization, privatization, airport city development, and long-term aviation growth strategies.

**Strategic Advisory**

* Lead aviation strategy, airport development, and business planning assignments.
* Advise clients on airport growth, capacity expansion, and long-term development strategies.

* Support aviation policy, market assessment, and infrastructure planning studies.
* Provide strategic recommendations to airport operators, governments, and investors.

**Commercial & Investment Advisory**

* Support airport privatization, PPP, concession, and transaction advisory assignments.
* Develop business cases, investment assessments, and growth strategies.
* Evaluate commercial opportunities, land monetization, and non-aeronautical revenue initiatives.
* Conduct strategic due diligence and investment attractiveness assessments.

**Market & Economic Analysis**

* Lead aviation market studies, traffic forecasts, catchment assessments, and benchmarking exercises.

* Support scenario planning and long-term demand assessments.

**Client Engagement & Business Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with key aviation stakeholders.
* Support proposal preparation, pursuits, and client presentations.
* Identify and develop new aviation advisory opportunities.
* Represent Jacobs at client workshops, industry forums, and strategic engagements.

**Project Leadership**

* Manage multidisciplinary project teams and advisory assignments.
* Ensure quality, commercial performance, and timely delivery of projects.
* Mentor and support the development of junior team members.

**Key Clients**

* Airport Operators and Developers
* Government and Civil Aviation Authorities
* Infrastructure Funds and Investors
* Airport City and Real Estate Developers
* Airlines and Aviation Stakeholders
* Multilateral Agencies and Financial Institutions

Here's what you'll need

* 10-15+ years of experience in aviation consulting, airport planning, infrastructure advisory, strategy consulting, or airport development.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airport strategy, business planning, investment, or development advisory projects.
* Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders, clients, and multidisciplinary teams.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Aviation Strategy & Airport Development
* Airport Economics & Business Planning
* Commercial & Investment Advisory
* Airport City & Land Development
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Business Development & Client Management
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Master's degree in Aviation Management, Transport Planning, Economics, Urban Development, Infrastructure Finance, or MBA.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:

Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

title: SAP CFIN Consultant
description:
Job Description: SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultant
  
  
**Location:**
PAN India
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled
**SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultant**
with specialized expertise in Payment Factory, Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing, and In-House Bank (IHB) solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Central Finance solutions within SAP S/4HANA environments. You will ensure seamless integration between source systems, SAP CFIN, and banking platforms to support centralized payment processing, cash management, and automated financial operations.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesSolution Architecture & Implementation
  
  

* Design, build, and support end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) solutions in SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Lead and execute Payment Factory implementations utilizing Central Payment features within CFIN.
* Configure and maintain Central Payment processes for centralized vendor and customer payments.
* Set up and manage In-House Bank (IHB) configurations and operational workflows.

Banking & Treasury Integration
  
  

* Implement and manage Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing and automated bank statement ingestion.
* Configure Bank Account Management (BAM), cash positioning, payment processing, and treasury integration.
* Partner with banking partners and middleware teams to establish secure, scalable bank interfaces.

Data Replication & Error Handling
  
  

* Manage continuous financial transaction replication, mapping rules, and system reconciliations between source systems and target CFIN environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and resolve replication errors using SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF).

Stakeholder Management & Project Lifecycle
  
  

* Gather and translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, configuration documents, and process flow diagrams.
* Lead functional testing cycles, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover execution, and hypercare support.
* Provide end-user training and post-go-live support to ensure operational readiness.

**Qualifications & SkillsExperience Required**

* Overall Experience: 5–10 years of core SAP Financial Accounting (FI) implementation and support experience.
* CFIN & Payment Factory: Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP CFIN and Payment Factory solutions.
* Banking Solutions: Demonstrated expertise in EBS ingestion, Central Payment, and In-House Bank (IHB) configuration.
* S/4HANA: Direct hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance projects.

Technical & Functional Core Competencies
  
  

* Deep functional understanding of SAP FI (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management).
* Technical proficiency in AIF monitoring, error resolution, object mapping, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of financial data replication architectures across multi-ERP landscapes.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations in high-visibility enterprise initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance certification.
* Exposure to SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) or Advanced Payment Management (APM).
* Experience with multi-national, multi-currency implementations and complex banking formats (e.g., ISO 20022, MT940, BAI2).

title: Store Manager
description:
About the role

The Store Supervisor is responsible for managing the factory store operations, ensuring timely

receipt, proper storage, accurate tracking, and issue of materials required for production. The role

ensures uninterrupted production by maintaining optimal inventory levels and enforcing proper

storage and material handling systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Material Receipt & Inspection**

* Receive incoming materials from suppliers as per purchase orders.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control department for inspection approval.
* Ensure proper documentation of Goods Receipt Notes (GRN).
* Report discrepancies, damages, or shortages to the Purchase department.

**Storage & Preservation**

* Ensure materials are stored in designated locations as per storage guidelines.
* Maintain proper labelling, binning, and identification of all items.
* Follow FIFO principles where applicable.
* Ensure safe handling and storage conditions to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration.
* Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of the store area.

**Material Issue to Production**

* Issue materials to production lines as per approved requisitions.
* Ensure timely supply of materials to avoid production delays.
* Maintain proper records of all issued materials.
* Coordinate with production supervisors regarding material requirements.

**Inventory Management & Tracking**

* Maintain accurate stock records (Bin card, ERP system).
* Monitor stock levels and inform Purchase for reorder planning.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and cycle counting.
* Investigate and report stock variances.
* Ensure proper tracking of fast-moving and slow-moving items.

**Store System & Compliance**

* Maintain updated documentation of all store transactions.
* Implement proper storage systems and improve layout efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and factory standards.
* Support internal and external audits.

**Team Supervision**

* Supervise storekeepers and store assistants.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of inventory management systems.
* Understanding of warehouse/store operations in manufacturing.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Tally, Oracle, etc.) preferred.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of safety standards and material handling.
* Problem-solving and organizational skills.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or related field (preferred).
* Relevant experience in factory or manufacturing store operations.

**Experience**

* 10 -15 years of experience in factory store/warehouse operations.
* Prior supervisory experience preferred.

title: Account Manager
description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

**About the Team -**

Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and

offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a

mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

**Role Summary -**

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

**Responsibilities -**

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with

internal stakeholders

Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is

correct and image coverage is high

Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for

month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.

Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.

to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.

Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers

and partners at the restaurants

Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance

metrics to the partner

Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable

conversions and grow the business.

Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,

conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,

commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and

explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations

(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (

reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

**Functional Competencies**

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.

Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads

RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)

Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise

transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

**Desired Skills -**

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working

knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing

channels

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.

Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people

at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.

Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness

and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal

drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. **Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**

description:
**Company Description**
Clubside Tours and Travels Pvt Ltd is a leading Destination Management Company with its registered office in Kolkata and branch offices in Darjeeling, Siliguri, Guwahati, Andaman, and Bhutan. The company specializes in crafting travel experiences across West Bengal, Sikkim, Bhutan, Andaman, and the Northeast, focusing on both natural beauty and cultural immersion. Services include cultural and wildlife tours, special interest itineraries, and adventure activities such as trekking, rafting, and riverside camping. **Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Travel Consultant role based in Kolkata. The Travel Consultant will design and customize itineraries, handle travel inquiries, and advise clients on destinations, accommodations, and transport options across the regions where Clubside operates. Daily responsibilities include managing bookings and reservations, preparing quotations, coordinating travel arrangements with vendors, and ensuring accurate documentation and confirmations. The role involves delivering responsive customer service, resolving travel-related issues, and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of regional attractions, regulations, and seasonal trends. The Travel Consultant will collaborate with internal teams to optimize tour packages and support the overall quality of client experiences.

* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Consulting and client advisory related to destinations, routes, and itineraries.
* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Management, including planning, coordination, and oversight of tour operations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Arrangements, covering transport, accommodation, activities, and vendor coordination.
* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, problem-solving, and client satisfaction.
* Candidates should possess skills in managing Reservations and booking systems with attention to accuracy and timelines.
* Good communication skills in English and regional languages, along with clear written and verbal interaction with clients and partners.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple inquiries, and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Prior experience in the travel or tourism industry, especially in domestic or adventure travel, is preferred.
* Proficiency with basic office software and online booking tools; familiarity with CRM or travel management systems is an advantage.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field is beneficial.
