title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Store Manager, you’ll oversee the entire customer experience, ensuring high visual and commercial standards that align with global strategies and your store’s local context. Acting in line with our values, you’ll drive both your success and the company’s success.

You will:

* Lead your store team to deliver an outstanding customer experience while promoting and selling our products.
* Stay informed about your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors, with a strong understanding of the local market and customer needs.
* Analyse sales performance, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage scheduling and store maintenance efficiently, aligning with sales budgets and commercial priorities.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.​

**WHO YOU ARE​**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* Experience in retail management and operations.

* A proven track record of strong leadership, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Proven results using customer centric reporting and tools.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and driving sales.
* Ambitious and motivated by performance, competition, and achieving goals.
* Analytical problem-solvers with excellent communication skills and a knack for working with numbers and statistics.
* Flexible and solution oriented.
* Passionate about fashion trends, commerciality, and visual presentation, with a keen awareness of competitors.

**WHO WE ARE​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​
**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​**
  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

* We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
* We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
* We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
* You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
* We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
* You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.
* We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

**JOIN US​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

​

**Additional Information**

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: SAP TM-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Advisory – SAP TM Functional Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Look For**
**What we offer you**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI**
**Role Overview**
Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary
**AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect**
, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a
**Developer Advocate**
and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.
  
  
This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.
  
  
As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization**

* Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.
* Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.
* Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.
* Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).
* Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.
* Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

**Data & AI Infrastructure**

* Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.
* Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.
* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

**Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture**

* Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.
* Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.
* Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

**GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy**

* You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.
* You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.
* Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

**Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership**

* Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.
* Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.
* Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.
* Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.
* Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.
* System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.
* Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.
* Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.
* Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.
* Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.
* Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).
* Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.
* Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.
* Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.
* Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

**Why Join Us?**

* Impact at scale—we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges.
* Modern technical foundation with room to innovate—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Hands-on architecture leadership—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.
* Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts, pushing the limits of what’s possible.
* Competitive compensation and high ownership—your work will define how Jumio scales.

**Jumio Values:**
IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
**:**
Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.
  
  
**About Jumio:**
Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.
  
  
Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.
  
  
**Applicant Data Privacy**
We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

title: AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect  ( L11 )
description:

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.
* Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design.
* Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis).
* Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium).
* Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams.
* Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges.
* Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact.

TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years

We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: Taxi Driver
description:
**Company Description**
P.Z. International operates passenger transportation services with a focus on reliable, safe, and customer-friendly taxi operations. The company aims to provide timely point-to-point travel for individuals, families, and business travelers across Kolkata and surrounding areas. P.Z. International emphasizes professional conduct, vehicle cleanliness, and adherence to local traffic and safety regulations. Team members are supported with clear procedures and guidelines to help them deliver consistent, high-quality service.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Taxi Driver role based in Kolkata. The Taxi Driver will transport passengers safely and efficiently to their destinations, following traffic rules and company guidelines. Daily tasks include accepting ride requests, planning routes, operating the vehicle in various traffic and weather conditions, and assisting passengers with boarding and luggage as needed. The role involves handling payments, providing clear information about fares, and maintaining a courteous, professional demeanor with all passengers. The Taxi Driver is also responsible for keeping the vehicle clean, reporting any mechanical issues, and coordinating with the company team regarding schedules and service requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Automotive: Strong driving skills, valid driver’s license, and familiarity with local traffic regulations and road networks.
* Training: Willingness to participate in company-provided training on safety, customer service, and operational procedures.
* Sales: Ability to promote company services through professional conduct and positive passenger interactions.
* Additional skills: Good communication skills, basic numeracy for handling fares, and the ability to work flexibly across shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Beneficial qualifications: Prior experience in taxi or commercial driving, knowledge of basic vehicle maintenance, and the ability to use GPS or navigation applications.

title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Why join Safeguard Global?**
👀
  
  
We want to help you
**“work in any way**
” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀
  
  
Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first — they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a
**job that works for you. ✅**
**The role in a nutshell:**
We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to support the management and ongoing optimization of Safeguard Global’s Salesforce Service Cloud platform. Reporting to the Senior Salesforce Administrator, this role will help maintain the day-to-day operations of Service Cloud, support system enhancements, and assist with user requests and troubleshooting. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with support and operations teams to translate business needs into platform configurations, automation, and reporting capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. While the primary focus of this role is Service Cloud, the administrator should maintain a general awareness of Sales Cloud functionality to ensure alignment across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will also support the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, helping implement automation and intelligent service workflows that enhance support operations and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**How you will make a difference:**

* Support the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, and performance.
* Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to implement system enhancements and platform improvements.
* Configure and maintain Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automation flows.
* Assist with user management, including account setup, permissions, and role-based access controls.
* Provide frontline support for Salesforce users by troubleshooting issues and responding to support requests.
* Collaborate with operations and support teams to gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with maintaining data quality and integrity through monitoring, data cleanup, and governance practices.
* Support testing, validation, and deployment of Salesforce updates and new features.
* Assist with the configuration and monitoring of AI-powered capabilities such as Agentforce agents and service automation workflows.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations that enable reliable data exchange and workflow synchronization between Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Workday, and other business platforms
* Document system configurations, processes, and user guides to support internal knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to ensure alignment across the Salesforce platform.

**What will give you an advantage:**

* 3+ years of experience working with Salesforce
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201) preferred
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of day to day workings in AWS Telephony platform for inbound and outbound contact handling
* Working knowledge of MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication, data mapping, and flow monitoring to support integrations between Salesforce Service Cloud and platforms such as Jira and Workday
* Basic familiarity with Sales Cloud concepts and objects to maintain cross-platform awareness.
* Experience configuring Salesforce features such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Exposure to Salesforce Flow or automation tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce or Einstein AI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical configurations
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

**Who we are and what we do:**
  
  
Safeguard Global is…global!
**We enable global expansion without the risk**
by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎
  
  
**Our Global Benefits**
:
  
  

* 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
* 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family
* 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
* 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
* ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
* ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
* 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.

  
  
**Next Steps:**
  
  
To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.

🌐
  
  
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

title: Generic - Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Customer is looking for experienced actuarial profiles in the ongoing Illustration Modernization initiative. The resources would analyze the existing actuarial calculation processes and part of the modernization programs. This role is for an experienced consultant with deep expertise in insurance quoting and insurance products responsible for advising business and technology stakeholders on optimized solutions that enhance quoting accuracy streamline product configuration
  
  
**Responsibilities**
candidate must have -
  
  

* Actuarial skills having around 10+ years of experience.
* Expertise building calculations in Excel spreadsheet.
* Experience on US Life Insurance products.
* Experience on new business and/or Illustrations .
* Lead end to end consulting engagements in the insurance domain by analyzing business objectives and translating them into robust quoting and product configuration solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Drive detailed assessments of existing insurance quoting workflows and systems to identify gaps inefficiencies and risks then recommend targeted improvements that reduce cycle time and enhance quote accuracy.
* Provide comprehensive guidance on insurance product structures rating logic underwriting rules and policy lifecycle processes to ensure that solution designs align with regulatory obligations and market expectations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and technical teams in a hybrid work model to elicit requirements validate solution options and ensure that insurance quoting and product changes are fully understood and correctly implemented.
* Develop clear functional specifications and process maps for new or enhanced insurance products and quoting capabilities enabling implementation teams to configure systems consistently and maintain data integrity.
* Oversee configuration and testing of insurance quoting functionalities in core platforms by defining test scenarios reviewing results and ensuring that defect resolution supports high quality releases in day shift operations.
* Guide the adoption of best practices in pricing discounting and underwriting decision support within quoting workflows so that front line users can generate compliant and competitive quotes with minimal rework.
* Coordinate impact analysis for proposed changes to insurance products and quoting rules explaining downstream effects on policy administration billing and reporting so that all dependent processes remain stable and predictable.
* Provide analytical insights using key performance metrics such as quote conversion turnaround time and loss ratio and recommend data driven improvements that support the organizations strategic growth and customer centric goals.
* Support business case development for new insurance product initiatives by estimating benefits resource needs and implementation timelines to help decision makers prioritize investments that deliver societal value through improved protection offerings.
* Mentor junior consultants and analysts in the insurance domain by sharing practical knowledge on quoting standards product design and stakeholder communication thereby strengthening overall team capability and delivery consistency.
* Engage proactively with operations and customer service teams to understand pain points in daily quoting and product usage then convert these insights into actionable enhancements that reduce manual work and improve service quality.
* Ensure that all consulting activities adhere to compliance policies data privacy expectations and regulatory requirements for insurance products so that solutions protect customers interests and uphold the organizations reputation.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience in insurance quoting to design and refine rating structures eligibility criteria and risk assessment approaches that support accurate premium calculations and transparent customer communication.
* Utilize deep expertise in insurance products across lines of business to shape coverage options endorsements and product variants that respond to evolving customer needs and market trends.
* Leverage nine to thirteen years of professional consulting or insurance industry experience to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and deliver solutions that balance business agility with operational stability.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in analyzing process flows and system behavior in hybrid working environments enabling effective collaboration across on site and remote teams without requiring travel.
* Use advanced problem solving and communication skills to translate technical details about insurance quoting and product configuration into clear guidance for nontechnical stakeholders and decision makers.
* Apply familiarity with day shift operational constraints to propose implementation and rollout plans that minimize business disruption while ensuring thorough training and adoption for end users.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include insurance domain credential such as Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter or equivalent industry recognized insurance qualification.

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

**Building & Infrastructure**
business across

**Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other strategic growth areas**
.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies, identifying and converting new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and expanding Dow’s route-to-market network. This includes working closely with distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other key industry stakeholders. Your ability to translate market trends and customer needs into actionable commercial strategies will be instrumental in strengthening Dow’s market position and delivering long-term business success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth strategies for the Building & Infrastructure business across Eastern India and Bangladesh, with a strong focus on Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated market segments.
* Expand and strengthen the retail route-to-market by developing high-performing networks of distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other channel partners to maximize market reach and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other key decision-makers to influence specifications and secure project opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities while maintaining a robust sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management from inception through closure.
* Drive value-based selling initiatives, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, and joint business plans that contribute to revenue growth, margin expansion, customer retention, and channel excellence.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Service, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to deliver customer value while providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and business updates to senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should possess:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Business, or a related field from a recognized institution. An MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, project sales, channel development, market development, or related commercial roles.
* Proven experience serving customers within the Building & Infrastructure, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, Architectural Solutions, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in developing and growing markets through distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and similar channel partners across geographically diverse regions.
* Experience managing strategic accounts, major projects, and specification-driven opportunities while influencing a broad range of stakeholders involved in purchasing decisions.
* A proven track record of independently developing markets, converting opportunities into sustainable business growth, and presenting business strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Eastern India and Bangladesh.

**Your Skills**

* Market development and growth strategy, with the ability to transform customer, channel, and competitive insights into executable business plans.
* Channel and retail development, including distributor management, dealer expansion, outlet penetration, and demand generation.
* Strategic account and project management, including stakeholder mapping, specification influence, and opportunity conversion.
* Value-based selling, commercial negotiations, and development of differentiated solutions that create customer value.
* Business planning and commercial analytics, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance tracking, and corrective action planning.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively present business strategies, market intelligence, and growth recommendations.

**Additional Notes**

* This position supports market development activities across Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* The business portfolio includes Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated Building & Infrastructure market segments.
* Extensive travel is required to develop customer relationships, strengthen channel networks, support project opportunities, and identify new areas for business growth.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Company: AniGears Engineering Solutions

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Experience: Minimum 10 years

Salary: ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month

About the Role

AniGears is seeking a highly experienced, energetic and technically sound Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead engineering activities across business development, reverse engineering, production coordination and mechanical equipment development.

The candidate will be the senior-most member of the engineering team and will be responsible for taking ownership of projects from customer enquiry and technical discussions through design, production and final delivery. The role requires strong practical knowledge, independent decision-making and the ability to manage both field and production responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Sales & Business Development

• Visit industrial clients and conduct technical and commercial meetings.

• Understand customer requirements, develop technical solutions, negotiate and close deals.

• Generate new business and maintain strong client relationships.

• Handle enquiries for mechanical components, power transmission products and complete mechanical assemblies and equipment.

2. Reverse Engineering & Design

• Conduct site visits and take accurate measurements of components and assemblies.

• Prepare mechanical sketches, dimensional drawings and CAD drawings.

• Handle reverse engineering and product development for components as well as mechanical equipment, including roller assemblies.

• Possess working knowledge of industrial couplings, Cardan shafts, sprockets, pulleys and other power transmission products.

3. Production & Engineering Operations

• Coordinate with vendors, workshops and production teams to ensure timely order execution.

• Understand machining, fabrication, fitting, assembly, inspection and other relevant manufacturing processes.

• Ensure production adheres to technical drawings, specifications, quality requirements and delivery schedules.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and take prompt corrective decisions.

• Be prepared to transition between field engineering and production operations as AniGears develops its own manufacturing capabilities.

4. Team Leadership & Project Management

• Assign tasks to junior engineers and monitor their progress and output.

• Review drawings, technical work and project execution.

• Coordinate engineering, procurement, vendors and production to ensure timely completion of orders.

• Take ownership of projects from initial enquiry to final dispatch.

• Make independent decisions and remain accountable for technical, commercial and operational outcomes.

Candidate Requirements

• B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in industrial mechanical engineering, power transmission products, machinery or mechanical assemblies.

• Strong practical knowledge of mechanical components, their construction, applications and working principles.

• Proficiency in mechanical measurements, technical sketching, engineering drawings and CAD software.

• Good understanding of manufacturing and production processes.

• Experience in technical sales, client handling, commercial discussions and team management.

• Energetic, proactive, decisive and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Important: We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer who can contribute from day one. Candidates must already understand industrial mechanical products and engineering practices. Basic product training will not be provided.

Compensation

₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and capability.

title: Co-Founder with Investment
description:
# Seeking Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner | ₹10 Lakhs+ Investment | Healthcare, Education & Technology
  
  
I am looking for an entrepreneurial \*\*Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner\*\* who can bring investment, sales and marketing expertise to help build and scale a healthcare-focused digital business with ambitions in India and globally.
  
  
## About Our Existing Digital Assets
  
  
We have developed multiple healthcare-focused websites and media assets that are receiving website traffic. We are now preparing to monetise these platforms and establish sustainable revenue streams.
  
  
\*\*Our current platforms include:\*\*
  
  
\*\*1. DentalClinicAlly.com — Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Helping Indian dentists with dental clinic setup consulting, business Planning, dental clinic growth strategies & Dentist Brand development.
  
  
\*\*2. DentistUpgrade.com — Dental Education & Government Job information - Career Platform\*\*
  
  
Our vision is to develop DentistUpgrade.com into a \*\*global training platform for dentists\*\*, offering:
  
  
\* Hands-on clinical training programmes.
  
\* Online courses for dentists.
  
\* Continuing professional learning opportunities.
  
\* Educational resources to help dentists enhance their clinical knowledge and professional skills.
  
\* Government Dental job listings and career-related opportunities.
  
  
\*\*3. Medihel365.com — Healthcare Digital Platform, Health care services provide Directory\*\*
  
  
An additional digital asset with potential to serve broader healthcare audiences as our business develops.
  
  
\*\*4. Chikitsa Katha & Medical Help 365days\*\*
  
  
Our medical-related YouTube channels, providing opportunities to develop healthcare education content and explore future monetisation.
  
  
## Our Long-Term Business Vision
  
  
We plan to build a broader healthcare services, education and technology business through four major areas:
  
  
\*\*1. Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Help dentists establish, manage and grow their clinics through practical business consultancy and customised growth planning.
  
  
\*\*2. Global Dental Training & Education\*\*
  
  
Build DentistUpgrade.com into a global platform offering hands-on training, online courses and professional learning opportunities for dentists.
  
  
\*\*3. Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency\*\*
  
  
Provide specialised digital marketing, lead generation and patient acquisition services to dentists, clinics and other healthcare service providers.
  
  
\*\*4. Patient & Clinic Management Software\*\*
  
  
Explore the development of software to support clinic operations, patient management, appointment workflows and practice administration.
  
  
Our initial focus will be on dentists, with plans to expand into other healthcare services as we validate demand and build our capabilities.
  
  
## Who Are We Looking For?
  
  
I am seeking a strategic partner who can contribute both capital and practical business-building expertise.
  
  
\*\*Key requirements:\*\*
  
  
\* Minimum proposed investment of \*\*₹10 lakhs\*\*.
  
\* Strong experience in sales, marketing, business development or entrepreneurship.
  
\* Ability to develop customer acquisition strategies and generate paying customers.
  
\* Experience in healthcare, dental education, digital marketing, EdTech, SaaS or HealthTech will be an advantage.
  
\* Ability to develop strategic partnerships with dentists, training providers, clinics and healthcare organisations.
  
\* A long-term vision for building a scalable healthcare business in India and internationally.
  
  
## Role & Responsibilities
  
  
The selected partner will work with me to:
  
  
\* Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies.
  
\* Acquire our first paying customers and establish repeatable revenue channels.
  
\* Build partnerships for dental training, education and healthcare services.
  
\* Develop revenue models for our existing websites and digital assets.
  
\* Explore opportunities in healthcare digital marketing and clinic management software.
  
\* Help establish and scale our dental education platform for a global audience.
  
  
## What We Bring
  
  
I bring \*\*12+ years of dental experience and experience owning two dental clinics\*\*, along with existing websites, digital platforms and healthcare-related media assets.
  
  
We have a foundation to build upon, and our current priority is to convert existing website traffic into paying customers, validate our business models and develop our future services progressively.
  
  
\*\*Please note:\*\* We are currently at an early stage of monetisation and are not yet generating revenue from these ventures. Our future initiatives will depend on market validation, investment and execution.
  
  
## Interested in Building This Business Together?
  
  
If you have the investment capacity, relevant experience and entrepreneurial mindset, I would welcome a discussion.
  
  
Please message me on LinkedIn with:
  
  
1. Your professional background and entrepreneurial experience.
  
2. Your sales, marketing, education or technology expertise.
  
3. Your proposed role and contribution.
  
4. Your investment capacity and expectations.
  
  
This is a \*\*co-founder and strategic investment partnership opportunity, not a salaried job\*\*. Equity participation, investment terms, responsibilities and governance will be discussed transparently and documented through appropriate legal agreements. Investment does not guarantee returns.
  
  
Let's explore the opportunity to build a healthcare, dental education and technology business with global ambitions.

title: Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the Role**

The corporate ecosystem needs tailored solutions to solve financial needs in a globally knit business environment. As an Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking Group, you will have the opportunity to manage the global trade finance, cash management (including payments and receivables), and banking needs of corporate clients. In addition, the role encompasses servicing client requirements across the financial spectrum. Hence, it is imperative that you analyze the available data to understand the client persona and subsequently offer the right solutions as part of the 360-degree banking framework. Leveraging technological platforms is at the core of providing clients a best-in-class experience. The role involves enhancing the relationship value with existing customers and onboarding new customers through lead generation from customers, vendors, dealers, and curated databases.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Increase relationship value:**
Managing Transaction Banking relationships of corporate clients with the aim to increase relationship value with impeccable focus on quality of service.

**Market understanding:**
Scoping the market for opportunities and understanding the competition, industry, and economy.

**Building relationships:**
Sourcing of new corporate relationships linked to existing relationships by offering the right solutions through the customer 360-degree approach.

**Collaboration:**
Ability to collaborate with multiple internal groups to provide efficient and innovative financial products to the mapped clients.

**Customer service:**
Facilitate day-to-day corporate needs and understand the intricacies of the products and services to ensure a seamless banking experience for the clients.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA, Chartered Accountants, Engineers & Graduates with relevant work experience in Trade Finance or Lending.

**Market Understanding:**
Ability to understand market dynamics, both at micro and macro levels.

**Communication Skill:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with the distribution team for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Interpersonal Skills:**
Build & maintain strong professional relationships with the customers.

**Domain Knowledge:**
Knowledge on finance, forex, and trade.

**About the Business Group**

The Transaction Banking Group at ICICI Bank services corporate clients across the country for their Cash Management and Trade Finance requirements. The group aims to service the requirements of import and export businesses (both domestic and cross-border) under Trade Finance and payments & collections under Cash Management. Transaction Banking is deeply interlinked with clients across Large Corporate Groups (LCG), Small and medium Enterprises (SME), MSMEs, Government Institutions, and PSUs. Clients are serviced by the on-ground team of Account Managers and Customer Service Managers ably supported by the Product Design team.

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the role

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service**

Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development**

Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking**

Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality**

Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions**

As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values**

Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification**

MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team**

Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise**

Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing**

Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication**

Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

title: Outreach Lead
description:
Organization

UXFoundery is a community where designers connect, learn, and grow together. We bring professionals from diverse design disciplines into one space to exchange ideas, explore new perspectives, and build meaningful relationships.

Through events, workshops, conversations, and collaborative experiences, we're creating a platform that supports peer learning, professional development, and connections across the global design ecosystem.

We're building UXFoundery from the ground up, with a vision to connect designers across cities and countries through a strong, collaborative community.

Role Description

We're looking for an enthusiastic and proactive
**Outreach Lead**
to help expand UXFoundery's community, establish partnerships, and build relationships across the design ecosystem.

This is a
**volunteer leadership opportunity**
for someone passionate about community building, networking, and creating meaningful professional connections.

As Outreach Lead, you'll take ownership of outreach initiatives, identify collaboration opportunities, connect with potential partners, and help UXFoundery grow its presence across colleges, companies, and design communities.

You'll work closely with our core team to plan outreach strategies, coordinate community initiatives, and turn conversations into meaningful collaborations.

**Candidates based in Kolkata will be preferred**
, as the role may involve in-person meetings, local community initiatives, and event coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* **Community Outreach:**
  Connect with designers, design leaders, speakers, creators, and potential community members.
* **Partnerships:**
  Build relationships with colleges, companies, organisations, and other communities.
* **Community Growth:**
  Identify opportunities to expand UXFoundery's reach across cities and international design communities.
* **Event Collaborations:**
  Support outreach for meetups, workshops, talks, and community events.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Maintain communication with partners, follow up on conversations, and nurture long-term relationships.
* **Research:**
  Identify relevant communities, organisations, potential collaborators, and growth opportunities.
* **Communication:**
  Help create outreach messages, partnership proposals, event announcements, and follow-up communications.
* **Ownership:**
  Take initiatives from ideation to execution while collaborating with the core team.

Qualifications

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build relationships and confidently initiate conversations.
* Interest in community building, networking, partnerships, or outreach.
* Strong organisational skills and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to research opportunities and identify potential collaborators.
* Experience in event coordination, student communities, design communities, or partnerships is a plus.
* A background in design, marketing, communications, or business is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership in an early-stage community.

Important Information

* **This is a volunteer role and is currently unpaid.**
* This opportunity is ideal for individuals who want to develop their leadership, outreach, partnership-building, and community management skills.
* You'll have the opportunity to contribute to building a growing design community and collaborate with designers and industry professionals.
* Candidates based in Kolkata will be preferred, but individuals from other locations with a strong interest in community building are welcome to express their interest.

Team Benefits & Perks

Although this is an unpaid volunteer role, you'll be part of the UXFoundery team and enjoy the following benefits:

* **Free Event Access:**
  Complimentary entry to all UXFoundery events as a team member.
* **Exclusive Team Swag:**
  Receive UXFoundery merchandise, swags, and goodies from the team.
* **Networking Opportunities:**
  Connect with designers, industry professionals, speakers, and community leaders.
* **Leadership Experience:**
  Build hands-on experience in outreach, partnerships, and community building.
* **Team Recognition:**
  Be part of the team shaping UXFoundery's growth and global community initiatives.

Interested?

If you're passionate about bringing people together and want to help build a community that makes a meaningful difference in the design ecosystem, we'd love to hear from you.

Send your introduction to hello@uxfoundery.com with a brief note about yourself, your relevant experience, and why you'd like to join UXFoundery.

Let's build a global design community together.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable.
