title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1_2+yrs
description:
**Job Description**
: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1
  
  
**Position:**
Microsoft 365 / O365 L1 Support Engineer
  
  
**Number of Openings:**
8 Resources
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Preferred)
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Support: Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Ticket Documentation: Maintain accurate ticket updates, troubleshooting records, resolution notes, and knowledge-base articles.
* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.
  
  
Skills: l1 support,troubleshooting,microsoft

title: UGC Content Creator (Remote Internship)
description:
**About Uzi World Digital**

Uzi World Digital is a digital marketing agency based in Kolkata, India. We offer web design, SEO, digital PR, social media marketing, online reputation management, branding, and digital advertising for brands, public figures, and creators.

**About the Internship**

Your first step into digital marketing can start in front of the camera. This internship gives college students the chance to become one of the faces of Uzi World Digital, creating short-form videos such as Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts that represent our work, culture, and values. It is built for students who are just starting out and want to learn how a digital agency works, with structured guidance and mentorship throughout and room to bring their own personality and ideas to the content.

**What You Will Do**

* Script, shoot, and edit short-form videos with guidance from our team. No prior editing experience is needed, training is provided, and mobile apps like CapCut are enough.
* Represent Uzi World Digital authentically on camera and through storytelling
* Develop video ideas with our marketing and creative teams, based on campaigns and trends
* Publish content on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and engage with the audience
* Learn to read basic analytics such as views, engagement, and shares to improve your content

**What You Will Get**

* Hands-on training in short-form video production, from idea to publishing
* Insight into how a digital agency handles content strategy, brand storytelling, and performance
* Mentorship from the founder and senior team members
* Real-world projects for your portfolio, across different industries
* Room to showcase your creativity and build your personal brand
* Certificate of Internship and Letter of Recommendation, based on performance and contribution
* Flexible remote schedule

**Who Can Apply**

This internship is strictly for students who are at the beginning of their journey. You are a good fit if you are:

* 18 years of age or above
* A first-year or early-stage undergraduate student currently enrolled in a college or university
* New to content creation, with little or no prior experience in video editing or social media management
* Comfortable on camera, curious about social media, and eager to learn from scratch
* Self-motivated and able to manage your time in a remote setup

This programme is built for beginners, so experienced creators may find it too introductory.

**What You Will Need**

* A smartphone with a good-quality camera, or a dedicated camera
* A clean, well-lit, presentable location to use as your background

**Internship Details**

* **Duration:**
  3 months
* **Commitment:**
  1 to 2 hours per day
* **Mode:**
  Remote
* **Applications:**
  Open year-round, reviewed on a rolling basis

**Please Note**

This is a learning-focused internship with no monetary compensation involved. It is structured as a training programme, and its value lies in mentorship, guided practice, real project exposure, and a certificate and letter of recommendation that support your early career. Content created during the internship will be published on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and may be reused by the agency for brand purposes. You are welcome to share your work on your own profiles as well. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email within 7 days.

title: Senior Manager - Regional Logistics
description:
**About the Job:**
We are looking for a dynamic Regional Logistics Manager to lead secondary distribution operations within the assigned branch territory. The role is responsible for ensuring best-in-class service levels at optimum cost, while staying fully compliant on storage, transportation, sustainability, safety and security standards.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that combines strategic network design with hands-on execution, working closely with Sales, O2C, Finance, Factories, HO Logistics, 3PL partners, transporters and Carrying & Forwarding Agents (CFAs) to deliver a seamless end-to-end distribution experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Distribution & Transportation Management**

* Manage Cost of Distribution (COD) by optimizing inbound and outbound delivery (E2E) to control Total Delivered Cost (FDC / VDC / % COD).
* Drive Distribution Network Redesign, Logistics Excellence and related projects across delivery transportation and downstream warehouse operations.
* Prepare the Transport strategy along with T-Hub, onboard new carriers for downstream operations, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Complete formalities and ensure recovery of accident/loss claims for primary and secondary movements.

**Warehouse & DC Operations**

* Lead DC improvement projects – manpower productivity, MHE utilization, DIDO/GIGO improvement, warehouse utilization – ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Prepare warehouse strategy and manage new infrastructure transitions in line with business volume progression (OPL/MBS).
* Ensure 100% cycle count and inventory accuracy along with adherence to internal & external compliance guidelines.

**Service Levels & Customer Fulfilment**

* Maintain COF / OTIF / ZATP, reduce CD OOS and secondary OTRs.
* Resolve CD complaints related to shortages/damages and drive corrective actions.
* Coordinate with the Sales team and O2C team to onboard new customers post CSP alignment and ensure full supply.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure cool chain compliance in downstream storage and transportation (DC to Distributor).
* Drive batch traceability, reefer service and chilled service strategies.
* Adhere to the company charter on supply and distribution of Infant Milk Substitutes and Infant Foods.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Identify and deploy advanced process improvement tools in warehousing (WMS, Dock Management, RF Implementation).
* Implement digital solutions in transportation – Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility, Digital Hygiene Checklist, LCOP, ERC, OVT.
* Roll out all Distribution-related HO projects (LER, CLER, Trainings, LVS) at the unit level.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage vendors and ensure formal execution of agreements with DC owners, CFAs and Carriers.
* Trigger transport events on a real-time basis and ensure timely issuance of detention certificates.
* Maintain strong P2P process compliance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA / PGDM from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution (full-time).
* 2 – 5 years of relevant post-MBA experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Transportation or Distribution within FMCG / Consumer / Supply Chain-intensive industries.
* Mandatory experience in managing Warehousing Operations and Transportation Management.
* Strong experience in team management, stakeholder engagement, coordination with Sales and Order-to-Cash (O2C) teams, and end-to-end execution ownership.
* Exposure to transformation and automation projects in supply chain / logistics.
* Working knowledge of SAP, WMS, TMS and digital logistics tools (e.g., Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility).
* Understanding of the FMCG value chain, freight market trends, and transport costing (fixed vs. variable)
* Knowledge of the local language of the region is an added advantage.

**Location:**
Kolkata

Full-time, work from office, with local travel

3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

* Maintain accurate records and ensure information is organized and up to date.

* Communicate professionally with US-based candidates, colleagues, and business associates.
* Assist with email correspondence and routine follow-ups.
* Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Handle multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good computer knowledge and proficiency in everyday office applications.
* Working knowledge of Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to multitask, follow instructions, and manage deadlines.
* Attention to detail and a proactive, responsible attitude.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Willingness and availability to work full-time during US business hours.
* Must have a personal computer or laptop and a reliable, high-speed internet connection.

Experience and Education
  
  

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with 0–2 years of experience in administration, executive assistance, recruitment
* Graduation in any discipline is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of IT, software technologies, or the IT industry will be an advantage.
* Previous exposure to US IT recruitment, HR operations, or executive assistance is desirable but not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Female candidates are preferred for this position, subject to applicable employment laws and LinkedIn's hiring policies.
* Candidates based in Kolkata, West Bengal, are preferred.
* Candidates who are comfortable working night shifts in India and coordinating with US-based professionals are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should be dependable, eager to learn, professional, and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to handle confidential business information professionally are essential.

Work Requirements
  
  

* 100% remote work.
* Full-time commitment during US Eastern Time business hours.
* Own computer or laptop is mandatory.
* Stable, high-speed internet connection is mandatory.
* Excellent English communication and professional conduct are essential.
* Ability to maintain productivity and coordinate effectively with a US-based team during the designated shift.

Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is ideal for freshers and early-career professionals who want to gain practical experience in executive assistance, recruitment coordination, and US IT staffing operations.
  
  
If you are organized, comfortable using computers, eager to learn, and capable of managing responsibilities independently, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Please apply only if you can commit to full-time remote work during the specified US business hours and have your own computer and a reliable internet connection.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Strassenburg Pharmaceuticals Limited is a pharmaceuticals manufacturing and marketing company based in Kolkata, India. The organization focuses on producing and promoting quality pharmaceutical products for diverse healthcare needs. As a growing company in the Greater Kolkata Area, Strassenburg offers opportunities to contribute to the healthcare sector through effective talent management and organizational development. Team members work in a dynamic environment that values compliance, operational efficiency, and responsible business practices. The company encourages collaboration, integrity, and long-term career growth.

**Role Description**
The Recruitment Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. In this role, the Recruitment Manager oversees end-to-end hiring processes, including workforce planning, job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection for various functions across the organization. The position is responsible for building effective recruitment strategies, partnering with hiring managers to understand role requirements, and ensuring a consistent, inclusive candidate experience. Daily tasks include managing recruitment metrics, coordinating with external agencies or platforms, conducting reference checks, and supporting offer negotiation and onboarding activities. The Recruitment Manager also contributes to employer branding initiatives, maintains compliance with relevant labor laws and company policies, and continuously improves recruitment processes through data and feedback.

* Ability to manage multiple requisitions, prioritize tasks, and use recruitment tools or applicant tracking systems efficiently.
* Knowledge of relevant labor laws, industry regulations, and best practices in fair, non-discriminatory hiring.
* Prior experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or manufacturing environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced HR certifications are beneficial.
* Proven ability to analyze recruitment data, track key metrics, and recommend process improvements.

description:

Serve as a senior content aggregation specialist within the Academy AF A function designing and operating robust hybrid solutions that unify learning data and digital assets from diverse enterprise and external sources. * Design and maintain scalable content aggregation workflows that collect normalize and classify learning materials from internal repositories and approved external sources to ensure a unified and reliable Academy catalog.

title: Creative / Design Head
description:

Kass • Full-Time Opportunity • Kolkata

**Role :**
Creative / Design Head

**Location :**
Kolkata (Work From Office)

**Experience & Availability :**
2–3+ Years • Immediate to 30 Days

**About Kass**

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**
thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**
who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**
, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**
  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**
  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**
  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**
  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**
  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**
  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**
  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**
  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**
  the department’s operational backbone, designing organizational systems and workflows that eliminate creative bottlenecks.
* **Integrate modern automation tools**
  , node-based workflows, and emerging AI technologies into daily production to exponentially scale asset variations and multiply team efficiency.
* **Collaborate closely**
  with Marketing, Performance, Product, and Operations to translate commercial goals into actionable creative solutions with minimal turnaround time.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Proven Leadership:**
  Demonstrated track record leading, managing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary creative or design team in a high-velocity environment (D2C, agency, or high-growth consumer brand).
* **Aesthetic & Technical Mastery:**
  Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) with strong working knowledge of 3D workflows, motion graphics, and emerging AI creative tools.
* **On-Set Production Eye:**
  Solid understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and macro product shooting.
* **Systems Thinker:**
  Someone who doesn’t just design, but builds scalable pipelines, templates, and automated workflows to elevate the entire department’s output.
* **D2C Performance Sense:**
  Deep intuition for modern consumer psychology, thumb-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and conversion-focused design.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts, Design, Animation, Visual Communication, or an equivalent battle-tested industry portfolio.

**Why Kass?**

At Kass, creative production is not an afterthought—it is the central engine of our brand equity and customer acquisition. If you have the vision to shape a rapidly scaling skincare brand and the operational muscle to lead a high-performing creative floor, we’d love to hear from you.

**cv**
and
**portfolio**
to sayani.bhattacharya@kasscare.com

description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. **Responsibilities**

* Expert Consultation: Preparation of higher complexity SR&ED tax incentive claims and assist with review of claims as required. Maintaining regular contact with assigned clients – communicating directly with client personnel in operations, finance, accounting, payroll, and engineering – and their accountants to gather relevant information to prepare project costing and complete tax return input.

Meet with clients in-person and virtually to establish engagement plans, assist with evaluation of eligible activities, and gather supporting documentation. Provide timely, high quality client service that meets or exceeds their expectations.

Enhance the SR&ED claim journey for clients, implementing streamlined approaches that ensure efficiency as client satisfaction is paramount.

* Financial Advisory: Offer specialized advice on tax credits and deductions, ensuring alignment with clients’ fiscal goals and optimizing financial gains. Stay abreast of changes to SR&ED federal and provincial programs and other relevant tax incentives. Comfortable with research as required, reviewing the Income Tax Act, CRA policies, and relevant case law.
* Business Insights: Cultivate a comprehensive understanding of clients’ operational landscapes, leading multiple engagements to success with informed strategies. Stay up to date with relevant internal and external professional development, pursue ongoing education opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* SR&ED Experience: We seek candidates with 4+ years previous experience claiming SR&ED tax credits and claim defense.
* Academic & Professional Background: A solid foundation in Accounting/Tax or related field, in public accounting and/or industry. Undergraduate university degree in business (accounting, tax, or corporate finance) or equivalent
* Software: Proficient using TaxPrep/iFirm and MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Client-Centric Approach: Outstanding client service abilities, complemented by superior communication skills.
* Collaborative Spirit: Ability to flourish in both autonomous and team-based environments, contributing to collective goals and milestones.
* Quality Focus: A self-starter who is detail orientated with a steadfast commitment to upholding quality and excellence in every project undertaken.

* Time Management Expertise: To effectively provide an outstanding client experience, it is essential to have the ability to juggle multiple client assignments, prioritize tasks, and work autonomously to meet deadlines.
* Interpersonal Skills: This role requires effective verbal and written communications and the ability to work professionally with other individuals and groups, ranging from RSM colleagues, to client stakeholders, to accounting partners, and to leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Academic & Professional Background: MPAcc or equivalent, and/or CPA designation for Manager level role, preferred but not required.
* Software: Proficient in other tax preparation software – ProFile, TaxCycle, CanTax, or others
* Provincial: Experience claiming Alberta Innovation Employment Grant (IEG) and/or Quebec R&D credit
* Tax Incentives: Experience with and/or interest in learning more about other Canadian tax incentive programs, federally and provincially.

title: Operations Executive (SCP)
description:
**Job Title**
: Executive Operations
  
  
**Function**
: Ground Operations
  
  
**Reports to**
: Senior Executive Operations

: SCP
  
  
**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

**Network Coordination & Exception Management**

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

**Workforce & Shift Leadership**

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

**Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management**

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

**Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication**

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high-volume, time-sensitive logistics environments.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**

* Hub & Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air & Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing & Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination & Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning & Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality & Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS & Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement & Productivity Enhancement
* Microsoft Office & Logistics Management Systems

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Leadership
* Decision Making Under Pressure
* Planning & Organising
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
* Team Leadership & People Development
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Customer Focus
* Accountability & Ownership
* Adaptability & Resilience
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Key Performance Indicators:**
**KRAs**
**KPIs**
Network Performance
  
  
On-time departure & arrival adherence, Network connectivity, Schedule adherence
  
  
Service Quality
  
  
SLAH %, Misroutes, Misconnections, Shipment processing accuracy, Scan compliance
  
  
Hub Productivity
  
  
Hub throughput, Vehicle turnaround time, Dock utilisation, Productivity per FTE
  
  
Fleet & Capacity Utilisation
  
  
Fleet utilisation, Vehicle availability, Capacity utilisation, Dispatch efficiency
  
  
Operational Excellence
  
  
Exception closure within TAT, Operational audit compliance, SOP adherence
  
  
Safety & Compliance
  
  
Safety compliance, Security compliance, Regulatory adherence, Audit scores
  
  
People Management
  
  
Team productivity, Employee engagement, Training completion, Attrition management
  
  
Continuous Improvement
  
  
Process improvement initiatives, Cost optimisation, Productivity enhancement, Operational efficiency gains
  
  
**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
  
  
Here’s what makes us stand out:
  
  
  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.
* Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work.
**Come grow with us.**

* Review and verify contractor measurements, RA bills, final bills, and supporting documents.

* Monitor quantities executed at site and reconcile them with approved drawings, BOQ, and contract provisions.
* Conduct joint measurements with contractors and site teams and maintain accurate measurement records.
* Review variation claims, extra items, deviation statements, and rate analysis for additional works.
* Monitor project costs, quantities, and expenditure against the approved budget and contract value.
* Assist in contract administration, including interpretation of BOQ, specifications, payment terms, and contractual provisions.
* Review contractor submissions related to claims, extensions of time, escalation, and other commercial matters.
* Coordinate with engineering, planning, construction, and project management teams for timely resolution of billing and quantity-related issues.
* Maintain records of measurements, bills, variations, quantities, and commercial correspondence.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports, cost statements, quantity reconciliation, and billing status reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contract conditions, Indian Railways/RDSO requirements, and applicable standards.
* Support the Project Manager in commercial and contractual matters related to railway civil works.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, billing, measurement, BOQ, rate analysis, and cost control.
* Good understanding of civil construction contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, AutoCAD, and quantity/billing software.
* Ability to independently verify contractor bills and assess quantities at site.
* Strong analytical, numerical, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors and project stakeholders.

* Experience in railway/metro infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in civil works such as railway formation, earthwork, bridges, culverts, stations, drainage, and other infrastructure works.
* Experience in EPC/Item Rate/Construction Contracts, contractor billing, variations, claims, and final account settlement.
* Knowledge of Indian Railways, RDSO, Metro Rail standards, SOR/DSR, and railway contract procedures will be an advantage.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Accurate and timely verification of contractor bills and measurements.
* Effective monitoring and reconciliation of quantities and project costs.
* Proper assessment and documentation of variations, claims, and additional works.
* Timely commercial and billing reports for project management.
* Compliance with contractual, technical, and financial requirements.
* Effective support to project management in QS, billing, and contract administration matters.

title: Creative Director
description:
**Company Description**
EDITFX STUDIOS PRIVATE LIMITED is a specialized provider of digital film cameras and post-production solutions, offering end-to-end services for film and video projects. The studio focuses on supporting filmmakers, production houses, and content creators with high-quality equipment and expert post-production capabilities. As a one-stop solution, EDITFX STUDIOS streamlines the technical and creative workflow from capture to final output. Team members collaborate closely with clients to deliver visually compelling and technically sound results that align with modern industry standards.

**Role Description**
The Creative Director will lead the overall visual and creative direction for projects handled by EDITFX STUDIOS in Kolkata. This contract, on-site role involves developing creative concepts, guiding branding and design language, and ensuring consistent art direction across digital film, graphic, and post-production outputs. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with production and post-production teams, reviewing and refining design work, providing clear creative briefs, and maintaining alignment with client objectives and brand guidelines. The Creative Director will also mentor creative team members, oversee key presentations to clients, and make final decisions on creative execution to ensure high-quality, impactful deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Creative Direction and Creative Strategy to lead concepts from ideation to execution.
* Candidates should possess skills in Branding to develop and maintain cohesive brand identities across multiple projects.
* Candidates should possess skills in Art Direction to guide visual style, composition, and overall aesthetic quality.
* Candidates should possess skills in Graphic Design to support the creation of high-quality visual assets and layouts.
* Relevant experience in film, media, or post-production environments, with a portfolio showcasing creative leadership.
* Ability to communicate ideas clearly, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Experience leading and mentoring creative professionals, with strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Design, Visual Communication, Film, Media, or a related field is preferred.

title: Safety Officer

Join us in our commitment to creating a safe and healthy workplace for all employees.

title: Manager - FP&A
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY – GDS**
–
**Consulting – Finance**
As part of our EY - Finance Consulting Team, you will help clients develop their Performance Improvement initiatives and identify potential opportunities for performance improvements drive them. This includes techno-functional role conducting finance processes assessments, deep diving and analysing pain areas and coming up with solutions. The client base spans across industries and countries.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in BPRA (Business Planning Reporting & Analytics), and BPRA Process Assessment assignments. Also, experience in, Financial Accounting and Reporting domain
**is an added advantage**
to join the global EY - Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledge on Financial Planning and Budgeting Processes, Financial Consolidation, Cost Allocation and Controllership, EPM tools
* Focus on the design and implementation of operating models in BPRA
* Design, configuration and implementation of BPRA processes in EPM tools
* Lead forecasting and financial planning process (Budgeting and long-range financial plan) for the client/enterprise by analyzing the trends of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as sales, expenditures, profit margin etc.
* Transform the overarching company strategy into a long-range plan, annual budget, capital budgets and forecast
* Advice capital allocation plan, revenue plan, Opex/Capex plan, and key cost drivers to create / revise Income statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Forecasts
* Model how BPRA teams use information from multiple sources to model new assumptions, run sensitivity analysis and test alternatives, leverages analytical models and systematic projections (using in market expectations and other macro-trends) to identify updates required
* Review and explain key drivers, managing risks and opportunities, and updated forecast with Regional and Local leads, consolidating submissions and revisions from BUs, adjustments made as needed
* Provide regular/ad hoc strategic support to executive leadership (onshore/client) and provide support on current and future outlook, target setting outcome etc.
* Identify improvement opportunities in BPRA domain
* Process re-design and optimisation (AS-IS & TO-BE) leveraging BPM tools
* Identification of KPIs for CXO reporting and dashboarding
* Perform vendor analysis and prepare relevant analysis reports for clients
* Configuration and know how on activity-based costing models
* Partner directly with onshore finance teams/clients to collaborate on metrics, goals and business reviews
* Perform cost Accounting & cost categorization (People & Non people cost)
* Standardisation and streamline close processes leveraging leading practices and technology
* CoA design/re-design as per management and statutory reporting needs
* Build Management Reporting in tools like Power BI / Tableau / Qlik Sense / OneStream / Jedox / Anaplan / Hyperion / Board EPM
* Good Knowledge on ledger and sub-ledger systems; technical know-how of SAP ERP / HANA, Oracle GL (good to have)
* Knowledge in finance functions – ‘Record to report’, processes involving account reconciliations, Journals, Transaction matching, Variance analysis, intercompany and Fixed assets accounting / management (Good to have process knowledge of Procure to Pay and Order to Cash)
* Working knowledge of GBS / SSC setup engagements
* Should have knowledge of activities in financial close of an organisation for month / Quarter / Annual close periods
* Translate business requirements to technical language and model (good to have)
* Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure
* Open to travel (Domestic & International)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks and adapt to a changing environment
* Must be organized, focused, and driven to meet established deliverable deadlines
* Ability to lead client workshops and guide on BPRA vision and strategy
* Agile, Learnability and problem-solving approach
* Consulting experience is a must have
* Confident & professional communication style
* Proficiency in English (oral and written)
* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
* Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
* 10-15 years of work experience in BPRA projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Finance Transformation
* GBS/SSC Setup
* Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience
* Exposure to tools like ERP, EPM tools, Visio, ARIS, etc.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY Advisory practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-Senior IAM Consultant-ISAM**
As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 6 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

JEEVMEDIA also manages a portfolio of exclusive international creators, offering premium brand collaborations, dedicated campaign support, and long-term growth opportunities. With a strong base in the global creator economy, the company is expanding across India. By combining global expertise with deep regional insight, JEEVMEDIA enables brands to leverage local influence for impactful, culturally relevant campaigns.

**Role Description**

You will maintain up-to-date records of talent profiles, performance metrics, and ongoing projects, and help prepare briefings, reports, and proposals for brand partnerships. The role also includes monitoring social media platforms for trends, supporting talent with content planning and scheduling, and ensuring timely execution of campaigns. You will collaborate closely with senior talent managers and the wider team to provide consistent support to creators and contribute to building a strong regional talent ecosystem.

* Candidates should possess strong communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills to work effectively with creators, brands, and internal teams.

* Candidates should possess social media literacy and basic digital marketing awareness, including familiarity with platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, and an understanding of influencer marketing trends.
* Candidates should possess analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to track campaign performance, interpret basic metrics, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills, with a proactive, professional approach to challenges in talent and campaign management.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, media, business, or a related field are preferred.
* Fluency in English and Bengali, plus familiarity with local culture in West Bengal and the Greater Kolkata Area, will be highly beneficial.

title: EVENTS & MEMBERS COORDINATOR - AUSTRALIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (ACCI)
description:
T
**he Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI)**
is the voice of Australian business—representing hundreds of thousands of organisations across every industry and state. From SMEs to major corporates, ACCI plays a critical role in shaping the policy settings that drive economic growth, job creation, and prosperity.
  
  
At the centre of national debate, ACCI advocates directly to government, regulators and international bodies to ensure Australia remains one of the best places in the world to do business.
  
  
Through its member network, events program and stakeholder engagement, ACCI connects business leaders, policymakers and industry representatives to share insights, strengthen relationships and support practical outcomes for Australian employers.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a hands-on coordination opportunity at the intersection of member engagement, events delivery and national business advocacy.
  
  
As Membership and Events Coordinator, you will support ACCI’s strategic priorities for member retention and growth by coordinating member services, stakeholder engagement initiatives and a national program of professional events.
  
  
Sitting within a collaborative national team, you will blend membership engagement and events coordination—supporting onboarding, renewals and partner fulfilment while helping deliver high-quality forums, roundtables, webinars, briefings and major business events. You will also assist with related marketing, communications, data and administrative activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
*Membership Engagement*

* Assist in the development and delivery of membership growth, retention and engagement initiatives across ACCI’s national network.
* Coordinate member onboarding, renewals, membership communications and ongoing engagement activities.
* Provide professional, timely and service-oriented support to members, prospective members and other stakeholders, responding to enquiries and facilitating access to ACCI benefits and services.
* Maintain accurate membership records, contact details, engagement information and member activity data within ACCI’s database systems.
* Assist in monitoring member engagement and preparing membership reports, insights and retention activities.
* Contribute ideas and practical support to enhance member experience, satisfaction and value.
* Support sponsorship and partner fulfilment activities, including coordinating partner benefits, stakeholder communications, branding requirements and deliverables.

*Events Coordination*

* Support the planning of ACCI events, including forums, roundtables, webinars, member briefings, stakeholder functions and major business events.
* Coordinate event logistics, including venue liaison, catering, audiovisual requirements, speaker coordination and event run sheets.
* Manage event registrations and attendee administration, including invitations, guest lists, RSVP tracking, event communications and registration reporting.
* Provide professional and responsive customer service to event attendees before, during and after events.
* Support on-site event delivery, ensuring a high-quality experience for members, sponsors, speakers, partners and guests.
* Liaise with suppliers, contractors and service providers to ensure successful event execution.
* Maintain event records, attendee data, feedback and post-event reporting.Assist with the development of event collateral, including invitations, programs, presentations, signage and briefing materials.

*Administration*

* Support marketing campaigns that promote ACCI events, membership, advocacy initiatives and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Assist with the creation and distribution of communications and marketing materials, including newsletters, website content, social media posts and promotional collateral.
* Assist with analysing membership, event and marketing data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Contribute ideas and practical support to enhance communications effectiveness, stakeholder engagement and operational processes.
* Work collaboratively across the ACCI team and undertake general administrative and coordination duties as required.
* Provide other support as directed by the Head of Partnerships and Growth and the Director of Strategic Events.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a national organisation at the centre of business advocacy while building experience across membership engagement, events, sponsorship support, stakeholder service, communications and data management.
  
  
**The Successful Applicant**
You are a highly organised, practical and service-oriented coordinator who enjoys bringing people, details, content and deadlines together. You are comfortable working in a busy environment, confident communicating with a wide range of stakeholders and motivated by the opportunity to support high-quality member engagement, events, marketing activity and communications.
  
  
**You Will Bring**

* Experience in events, membership, stakeholder engagement, marketing, communications, administration or a related coordination role.
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with members, senior stakeholders, suppliers and colleagues.
* High attention to detail across records, registrations, communications, marketing materials, event collateral and member information.
* Sound digital capability, including proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and confidence using CRM, database, online registration, email marketing, social media or webinar platforms.
* The ability to prepare accurate, engaging and audience-appropriate content for newsletters, websites, social media, briefings and member communications.
* Comfort working with data and records, with the ability to maintain accurate information and identify basic trends, opportunities or areas for improvement.
* A collaborative, positive and proactive approach, with sound judgement and a willingness to contribute across a small, high-performing team.
* The ability to work calmly under pressure and provide practical support during busy event, campaign or membership periods.

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience in a membership-based organisation, business association, not-for-profit, peak body or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting business events, conferences, forums, webinars, stakeholder briefings or member engagement programs.
* Familiarity with association management systems, CRM platforms, event registration tools, email marketing platforms, website content management systems or social media scheduling tools.
* Experience assisting with marketing campaigns, newsletters, digital content or social media for an organisation with multiple stakeholder audiences.
* You are energised by the opportunity to support events, member engagement and communications that connect Australian businesses with the people, ideas and policy discussions shaping the national agenda.

What’s on Offer
  
  
A unique opportunity to support events, membership engagement, marketing and communications activity for Australia’s peak business organisation.
  
  
Direct engagement with members, industry stakeholders, government representatives and national partners.
  
  
A varied coordination role across events, membership, content creation, data management, communications and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
The opportunity to contribute to professional events, campaigns and member initiatives with national visibility and real impact.
  
  
A collaborative and high-performing team environment based in Canberra.
  
  
**How To Apply**
All applications should be
**submitted to info@acci.com.au**
with the following documents:
  
  
Cover letter
  
  
Resume/CV
  
  
We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, LGBTQIA+ people, and people from culturally diverse backgrounds.
  
  
***Applications close 5:00 pm Wednesday, 21 October 2026.***
Early applications are advised as ACCI reserves the right to close the vacancy early if suitable applications are received.
