title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

title: ST - Telco-Aria Billing Cloud -Senior
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
* Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.

* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Outbound Lead Development Representative - International
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai

Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142+ customers across 65+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.

We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035

**About the Role**

* Demand generation engine of our international outbound motion, covering UAE, India, APAC, Europe, GCC and the Americas
* Research target companies in our focus industries and develop interest into sales-ready opportunities
* Move each contact from Prospect (MQL) to a sales-qualified lead (SQL) that Sales accepts, with a meeting on the calendar
* Full-cycle prospecting seat: you own the bridge into Sales, you do not negotiate or close, and you carry no pricing authority
* Fully digital and desk-based, with no field visits

**Research and Target**

* Identify and research target companies across all markets against the defined ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Build and maintain target account lists by market
* Map the decision-makers and buying committee in each account

**Enrich and Maintain Data**

* Source and validate contact information using approved tools
* Keep every prospect record in CRM accurate, complete and up to date, tagged by market

**Pitch and Develop**

* Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp (where applicable)
* Personalise every message to the account and its market, and follow the defined sequences and cadences
* Open real conversations with plant, EHS, safety and procurement buyers

**Qualify MQL to SQL**

* Run a structured qualification against the criteria set by management and Sales for each market
* Capture buying signals and make an honest qualify or reject call on every lead
* Understand each account's scope and potential

**Fix the Meeting**

* Secure a genuine meeting or next step with Sales across time zones and hand over cleanly
* Move real opportunities forward, not just pricing requests

**Build Qualified Pipeline**

* Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline for Sales, with clear opportunity value by market

**Keep the CRM Honest**

* Log every contact, activity, disposition and stage in CRM in real time

**Feed the Loop**

* Track outreach and conversion metrics by market and join the weekly performance review
* Share learnings back to demand generation and Sales so targeting and criteria keep getting sharper

**How Success Is Measured**

* MQL to SQL qualification against the agreed criteria for each market
* SQL acceptance by Sales: a meeting fixed and taken forward, not just a request for pricing
* Pipeline value handed to Sales (for example, USD pipeline developed)
* GP contribution from qualified opportunities that convert into orders

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-4 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, presales, SDR / LDR or outbound business development
* Comfortable owning a daily qualification and calling number
* Hands-on outbound experience (required): reached out to business prospects, run discovery and qualified them
* Strong internet research skills; ideally has researched accounts on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar

**Technical Skills**

* CRM familiarity (required), ideally Zoho CRM, with clean dispositions and stages
* Qualifies with a method (BANT / CHAMP / SPIN or similar), not gut feel
* Can read an account's scope and potential
* Plus: tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Lusha

**Functional Skills**

* Strong communicator with international buyers: clear, confident written and spoken English
* Comfortable with plant, EHS, safety and procurement contacts across cultures and time zones
* Gets the meeting: moves a conversation to a fixed next step, not a soft maybe

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to international markets
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, SaaS or B2B services
* Exposure to technical / industrial products or PPE

**Application**

* Include a link to your 90-second video introduction (questions are in the application form)

**Benefits**

* Own the gate: the call on what is a real opportunity and what is noise is yours
* Learn B2B selling properly: real discovery with real buyers and a real method
* A mission that matters: every account you qualify moves a real plant closer to safe
* Fully remote within India, or office-based at Kolkata HQ (South City Business Park, Anandapur)
* Working hours aligned to the time zones of your assigned markets, agreed at offer stage
* Everything runs on Zoho One

description:

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred

title: Senior Analyst -I Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
  
  
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
  
  
We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
  
  
**About The Position**
A Senior Analyst I works with our clients (banks and non-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing both quality control work related to the work of our Associate Analysts, and performing his/her own detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures. In short, you are on the front-line of making decisions as to how to keep clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst I, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
  
  
You may perform quality control activities, supervisory responsibility on occasion and be responsible for ad hoc communication with client. You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work, and you must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures, escalating where appropriate for second level review· Ability to perform quality control work as needed.
* Assist with advanced tasks including communication with clients, analyzing production data and creating client specific aids and training.
* Independently assist analyst with workflow items and administrative tasks as they arise.
* Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
* Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
* Work and contribute in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.
* Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti-Money, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 2-3 year of relevant AML/BSA experience.
* Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint & Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Certification
* Strong knowledge of banking industry and related regulations and laws.
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities for improvement.

**Normal Working Hours and Conditions**
Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position may require work to be performed outside of the core business hours based on Company operations across different time zones.
  
  
AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

City New York Location type Hybrid About Us

Execor is a global organizational consulting firm. We help clients synchronize strategy and talent to drive superior performance. We work with organizations to design their structures, roles, and responsibilities. We help them hire the right people to bring their strategy to life. And we advise them on how to reward, develop, and motivate their people.

Our 10,000 colleagues serve clients in more than 50 countries. We offer five core solutions:

* Organizational Strategy
* Assessment and Succession
* Talent Acquisition
* Leadership Development
* Total Rewards

Job description

The Associate Consultant’s role is to contribute to the effective running of bids, account plans, projects and/or client engagements by carrying out targeted research and analyses. This is typically the level for an experienced analyst, able to work with limited guidance and on own initiative. Work will be scoped, allocated then reviewed by a more experienced colleague. The focus is on client delivery supporting others as part of a team. At this level there can be direct interaction with clients, but the bulk of work will be desk/office-based. Some analytical support may be business development focused but this is not a major accountability area.

Primary Responsibilities

* Deliver high-quality work that meets expectations for timeliness, accuracy, and completeness.
* Work effectively with team members to cooperate and exchange information efficiently. This includes organizing your work activities to fit with the plan.

description:
**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Completing conceptual and/or detailed process engineering designs of new or revamp/additions to existing facilities.

* Conceptualizing flowsheet, Review of Metallurgical test work, design development, Process Simulations, Mass & Water balance, Utility Summary, PFD, equipment sizing calculation and selection i.e., Cyclone, Pumps, Dewatering screens, Tanks Valves, Crusher, feeders, sand washing plant and all other associated equipment like Columns Heat Exchangers, working on process design basis and criteria, basic & detail engineering deliverables, Vendor support etc.

* Perform Hydraulic Calculations for circuits (Slurry service and non-slurry service – Newtonian and Non-Newtonian fluid both)
* Relief Load Estimation by scenario analysis and Preparation of PSV datasheets, cause and effect diagram, process control narrative, Sequence Interlock Diagrams, Operating manual / procedure. Lead in HAZOP and other safety studies.
* Preparing Operating Cost estimate and aid in the development of Capital Cost estimate.
* Interfacing and coordination between other discipline engineers and project management staff.
* Reviewing and applying relevant standards, regulations, codes, and guidelines applicable for task, identifying areas of deviation or concern.

Demonstrated commitment to quality and continuous learning

**Quality Responsibilities**

* Participate and cooperate with internal/external audit process as required.

Participate in Quality initiatives and suggest modifications or improvements to current procedures if required.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* A Bachelor or Masters degree in Metallurgy, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering required.
* Senior level (12+ years) of relevant professional

**Technical And Industry Experience**

* Strong computer skills, proficient with MS Office software.
* Experience in using METSIM, SysCAD, HSC, Aspen and other process simulation software is considered an asset.
* Ability to deliver best practice plant design, with emphasis on cost-effective engineering.
* Ability to recognize the commercial implications in study, project and proposal execution.

title: Specialist ADC-Process
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Subject Matter Expert in ADC, candidate should possess following as a minimum
  
  

* Strong Technical Skills in carrying out basic and detailed engineering work. The candidate should be experienced in handling ADC projects including RnD Lab & QC lab.
* Should be able to prepare Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
* Should have strong knowledge on layout designing of ADC plants
* Should be able to independently carry out Capacity Mapping of ADC Plants
* The candidate should possess sound knowledge on equipment selection criteria for ADC Products from lab scale to commercial scale production.
* Should have knowledge on latest ISPE Guidelines
* Should be aware of regulatory requirements of USFDA, MHRA, WHO, TGA etc.
* Performing All process engineering calculations like heat & mass balance, Utility sizing (Clean & Black), Thermal rating of heat exchangers and hydraulics, line sizing, Pump Hydraulics
* Vendor Document Review
* Reviewing all aspects of design and construction for consistency and safety, including leading HAZOP and PHA Reviews
* Possess thorough knowledge on containment techniques and be able to perform Containment Studies.
* Provide guidance in GMP reviews.
* Containment selection for OEL less than 0.01 mg/m3
* Waste Handling from ADC plants
* Raw Material Handling & Storage

Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Skills And Competencies Required**

* BE Chemical with 15- 25 years Experience in Design Engineering
* Must have experience of design consulting organization either working currently or in the past in Lifesciences Projects
* Experience in Major Peptide projects

Reports to
  
  
DM- Process
  
  
Key India Connections
  
  
India Section Leaders and Technical Leaders providing resource to our projects
  
  
Leadership team/s
  
  
Project Managers, Design Managers, Project Directors, Section Leaders
  
  
Key Connections
  
  
Global Section Leaders and Technical Leaders providing resource to our projects
  
  
Global Integrated Delivery offices providing resource to our projects
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: SAP Project System Consultant in India
description:
* Position: Senior SAP PS Consultant
* Location: Bengaluru (On-site)
* Experience: 8+ years in SAP, including 6+ years in SAP PS
* Budget: Up to 1.2 lakh per month
* Availability: Immediate joiners only
* Project: BIAL Airport Infrastructure Programme

**Job Description**
**Senior SAP PS (Project System) Consultant**
Contract | 8+ years | Bengaluru (on-site) | BIAL airport infrastructure programme
  
  
Position
  
  
Senior SAP PS (Project System) Consultant
  
  
Engagement type
  
  
Fixed-term contract, [duration] months, extendable based on project need and performance
  
  
Client / project
  
  
Bangalore International Airport Limited (BIAL) capital projects and infrastructure programme
  
  
Location
  
  
Bengaluru, Karnataka on-site at the client location (Kempegowda International Airport, Devanahalli)
  
  
Total experience
  
  
8+ years in SAP, of which at least 6 years in SAP PS
  
  
Implementations
  
  
Minimum 2 end-to-end SAP PS implementations, at least 1 on SAP S/4HANA
  
  
Availability
  
  
Immediate to 30 days preferred
  
  

* Role summary

ATC is looking for a hands-on Senior SAP PS Consultant to lead the Project System workstream for BIAL s capital and infrastructure programme. You will design, configure and support the full project lifecycle in SAP: structuring, planning, budgeting, procurement, execution, progress measurement, settlement to fixed assets and reporting. The role calls for deep knowledge of PS configuration and of its integration with CO, FI-AA, IM, MM, SD and PM in an asset-heavy, capex-led environment.
  
  

* Key responsibilities

**2.1 Solution design and configuration**

* Lead requirement workshops with BIAL s project, engineering, finance and procurement teams, and turn capex processes into SAP PS designs (business blueprint / fit-to-standard, functional design documents).
* Design the project structure: project definition, WBS hierarchy, networks, activities (internal, external, general cost and service), activity elements and milestones, aligned to BIAL s capital project, cost-centre and asset classes.
* Configure project profiles, network profiles, network types, coding masks, number ranges, status profiles, budget and planning profiles, settlement profiles, results analysis and progress analysis.
* Build and maintain standard structures (standard WBS and standard networks) for repeatable airport project types such as terminal works, airside works, utilities, landside and IT infrastructure.

**2.2 Cost planning, budgeting and availability control**

* Set up cost planning by structure, Easy Cost Planning, unit costing and network costing, using appropriate costing variants and planning versions.
* Configure budgeting: original budget, supplements, returns, transfers, releases and budget carry-forward at year end.
* Design and test availability control: tolerance limits, activity groups, actions (warning, error, e-mail) and exempt cost elements, and activate and reconstruct availability control.
* Integrate PS with Investment Management (IM): investment programmes, positions, appropriation requests, programme budget distribution to WBS elements, and IM PS budget consistency.

**2.3 Execution, procurement and logistics integration**

* Configure MM integration: purchase requisitions from external and service activities, account assignment to WBS and network, material components, reservations, project stock (valuated and non-valuated) and MRP for project materials.
* Configure service procurement for contractor works (service entry sheets) and commitment management against WBS budgets.
* Set up confirmations (individual, collective, CATS timesheets), confirmation parameters, work centres, activity types and capacity planning.
* Configure dates and scheduling: basic, forecast and actual dates; scheduling parameters; relationships (FS, SS, FF, SF); float; and network rescheduling.
* Integrate PM work orders and maintenance costs with WBS elements where needed.

**2.4 Progress, revenue and period-end**

* Configure progress analysis and earned value management: progress versions, measurement methods (milestone, start finish, degree of processing, time-proportional, quantity proportional, estimation) and POC reporting.
* Configure results analysis (RA keys, RA versions, valuation methods including POC and revenue-based) where projects are billable or revenue-bearing.
* Configure billing integration where applicable: milestone billing, billing plans, down payments and resource-related billing (DIP profile).
* Configure and run settlement: settlement rules, settlement profiles, allocation and source structures, periodic and full settlement, and settlement of assets under construction (AuC) to final fixed assets, including line-item settlement.
* Support period-end and year-end processes: overhead calculation (costing sheets), interest calculation, results analysis, settlement, commitments carry-forward and budget carry-forward.

**2.5 Reporting, testing, data and support**

* Deliver PS reporting: structure overview, cost and budget reports, line-item reports, commitment and payment reports, and S/4HANA Fiori analytics, as well as custom reports through functional specifications.
* Write functional specifications for RICEFW objects (reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows) and work with ABAP and integration teams to deliver them.
* Lead data migration for projects, WBS, networks, budgets and open commitments using the S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, LSMW or BAPIs.
* Plan and run unit, integration (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT); prepare test scripts; and resolve defects.
* Prepare training material and end-user guides, train key users, provide hypercare after go-live, and handle incidents and change requests within agreed service levels.
* Technical skills matrix

Candidates must show hands-on experience, not just awareness, in the areas marked Mandatory.
  
  
**Area**
**Level**

* Mandatory requirements
* 8+ years of SAP experience, with at least 6 years of hands-on SAP PS configuration.
* At least 2 full-cycle SAP PS implementations, including at least 1 on SAP S/4HANA, plus experience in support or rollout projects.
* Strong grasp of capex and capital project accounting: budgeting, availability control, AuC and capitalisation.
* Proven integration experience with CO, FI-AA, IM and MM; working knowledge of SD and PM integration.
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with ABAP, BTP and integration teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, at the client location, for the full engagement.
* Preferred requirements
* Domain experience in airports, aviation, infrastructure, EPC, construction, utilities or the public sector.
* Experience integrating SAP PS with Primavera P6 or MS Project for scheduling.
* Exposure to SAP Activate methodology and SAP Solution Manager or SAP Cloud ALM.
* SAP certification in Project System or S/4HANA Portfolio and Project Management.
* Bachelor s degree in engineering, finance, commerce or a related field; MBA or CA / ICWA is an advantage.
* Behavioural competencies
* Clear communication with senior client stakeholders in project, engineering and finance teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to documentation.
* Ability to work independently in a client-facing, deadline-driven programme.
* Ownership of deliverables and quality, from design through to hypercare.

title: TC - IAM - Senior - Cyberark- GIG
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- PAM Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Principal Architect)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud, Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio, as well as familiarity with Agentforce.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

description:

**About Submer**
At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.
  
  
**Your impact**
**We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Junior Electrical Engineer. The ideal candidate is a proactive "go-getter" who can effectively engage with clients, quickly understand their needs, and convert conversations into business outcomes.**

We are seeking a motivated Junior Electrical Engineer to support the design, engineering, commissioning, and delivery of innovative liquid-cooled data centre solutions. The role provides exposure to global projects and mission-critical infrastructure.

* Assist in preparing electrical layouts, SLDs, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts.
* Support load calculations, cable sizing, voltage drop, and protection coordination.
* Support electrical design for liquid-cooled data centre solutions.

* Prepare BOMs, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Support FAT, SAT, installation, testing, and commissioning.

* MS Office proficiency.

* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

0–2 Years

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering

title: SAP TM Functional Consultant
description:
Job Description: SAP Transportation Management (TM) Consultant
  
  
**Position:**
SAP TM Functional Consultant
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience Level:**
Mid-Senior Level (3+ Years)
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented
**SAP Transportation Management (TM) Consultant**
with a minimum of
**3 years of experience**
to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in configuring, customizing, and implementing SAP TM solutions, along with working knowledge across related S/4HANA functional domains. You will play a pivotal role in designing solution architectures, writing functional specifications, determining data requirements, and providing ongoing optimization and support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Module Configuration & Implementation: Design, configure, customize, and deploy SAP TM functionalities to optimize end-to-end transportation planning, freight order management, execution, and carrier selection.
* Requirements Gathering & Functional Design: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand complex business processes, gather requirements, write detailed Functional Specifications (FS), and recommend industry best practices.
* Data Management: Determine and define data requirements directly from process/solution documentation, leveraging high proficiency in MS Excel for data mapping, analysis, and validation.
* System Integration: Configure and manage integrations between SAP TM and other S/4HANA core modules (e.g., OTC, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing) as well as third-party systems.
* Training & User Enablement: Conduct workshops, training sessions, and structured knowledge transfer for business key users, end-users, and project delivery teams.
* Support & Maintenance: Provide ongoing application support, complex troubleshooting, system enhancements, and maintenance for SAP TM landscapes.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest SAP S/4HANA and TM innovations to propose continuous process improvements and feature adoption.

**Required Qualifications & Skills1. Core Functional Expertise**
  
  

* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Transportation Management (TM) implementation, rollout, and support.
* Good functional understanding of one or more core S/4HANA functional areas:

+ OTC (Order to Cash)
+ P2P (Procure to Pay)
+ R2R (Record to Report)
+ Manufacturing / Digital Supply Chain

* In-depth knowledge of S/4HANA data objects within the candidate's core functional areas.
* Technical & Process Capabilities
* Proven experience in writing comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom development objects (RICEFW).
* Ability to interpret solution/process documentation to identify and extract data requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for data modeling, mapping, and project reporting.
* Experience in system configuration, freight order management, transportation planning, carrier selection, and freight settlement.
* Soft Skills & Professional Attributes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities to navigate complex business workflows.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting solutions to business stakeholders.
* Strong team player capable of working effectively in multi-disciplinary project teams.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* SAP Certification: Official SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Transportation Management.
* Exposure to integrated S/4HANA Supply Chain modules (e.g., EWM, SD, MM).
* Prior experience with data migration tools and data loading processes.

title: Technical Management Professional Networks
description:
**Company Description**
BT Group is one of the world’s leading communications services companies, providing solutions that are essential to modern life. Guided by the purpose “we connect for good,” BT Group focuses on enabling individuals, businesses, and communities to communicate and collaborate effectively. As technology reshapes how people live and work, the company’s networks and services support customers in staying connected and productive. BT Group plays a key role in addressing global challenges such as pandemics, climate change, and cyber security through innovative, technology-driven solutions. Team members contribute to meaningful work that helps people live, work, and play better together.

**Role Description**
The Technical Management Professional Networks role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves managing and optimizing network infrastructure, monitoring performance, and ensuring high availability and reliability of services. Day-to-day responsibilities include troubleshooting network issues, coordinating with internal teams and external partners, and implementing changes and upgrades in line with best practices and security standards. The professional will prepare and maintain technical documentation, support incident and problem management, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. The role also includes collaborating with stakeholders to align network operations with business objectives and customer experience goals.

* Strong foundation in computer networks, including routing, switching, network protocols, and basic security principles.
* Experience with network monitoring, incident management, and troubleshooting tools in an operational or technical support environment.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, create clear reports, and maintain accurate records of network configurations and changes.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional teams and interact with stakeholders at different levels.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on service quality and reliability.
* Willingness to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area and adapt to evolving technologies, processes, and business needs.
* Industry certifications in networking or telecommunications (e.g., CCNA, Network+, or equivalents) are beneficial.

* Minimum 4+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 / O365 technical support.
* Hands-on experience in L1/L2 support and incident management.
* Strong troubleshooting knowledge of Outlook and Exchange Online.

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, user provisioning, and license management.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, ticket management, and SLA-based support.

**Preferred Skills**

* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience supporting enterprise users in a corporate IT environment.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Candidates must have 4+ years of relevant Microsoft 365/O365 support experience.

* Strong customer service orientation and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently are essential.

O365 Support, Microsoft 365, L1 Support, L2 Support, Outlook, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, Azure AD, MFA, ITSM, Incident Management, SLA, PowerShell.
